evals.description: Describe the explicit merge workflow that synchronizes the default branch and cleans only the current linked worktree after proof of merge.
evals.prompt: I am in a clean linked feature worktree with a pushed branch and an open PR. Run the reusable shipping workflow with a conventional commit if needed, create or reuse the PR, squash-merge it after checks, update local main, and clean up only this worktree. Use the explicit safe option and describe what must be verified before cleanup.
evals.expected_output: The assistant uses arc-git-pr-check with --ship merge --update-main, waits for or verifies a successful merge, fast-forwards the default branch, and removes only the current clean linked worktree and its local feature branch.

assertions.prompt: The response should require confirmed PR merge metadata and fetched default-branch evidence before removing the current worktree or branch.
The response should preserve unrelated worktrees and refuse cleanup when the default or current worktree is dirty or the update is not fast-forwardable.

evals.description: Adjacent negative: PR-first and auto-merge modes do not perform post-merge main synchronization or worktree cleanup.
evals.prompt: The PR is still open and I want to use arc-git-pr-check --ship pr or --ship auto. Should the workflow update local main or delete the feature worktree now? Explain the safe behavior.
evals.expected_output: The assistant leaves the worktree and branch in place, does not use --update-main without --ship merge, and does not clean up before a confirmed merge.

assertions.prompt: The response should explicitly refuse to update main or remove the feature worktree while the PR is open or auto-merge is merely enabled.
